categories.feature: Native histogram storage/evaluation is not supported.
The experimental info() function is not supported.
The experimental limitk/limit_ratio aggregations are not supported.
Start timestamps (@st, start_timestamp()) are not stored or evaluated.
Trigonometric functions are not implemented.
Experimental duration expressions in PromQL are not enabled.
Experimental binary-operator fill modifiers are not enabled.
Experimental anchored/smoothed range selectors are not enabled.
Prometheus 3 delayed __name__ removal is not implemented; label_replace/label_join cannot recover a name dropped earlier.
ClickHouse samples have no staleness markers; staleness is approximated by the 5m lookback.
Native histogram samples are stored but not queryable; the adapter returns an explicit error.
categories.error_regex: skopos: native histogram samples are not supported

categories.feature: Cases that expect native histogram points in the result are not supported.
Subqueries are not supported.
Functions outside the published support list return an explicit unsupported-function error.
Experimental PromQL syntax/function gates required by the case are not enabled.
PromQL warning/info annotations are not emitted.
Prometheus 3 __type__/__unit__ metric metadata labels are not implemented.
The quantile aggregation is not implemented.
expect ordered result checks are not met; the HTTP API does not guarantee result ordering.
Top-level string literals are not supported as query results.
Instant queries returning a range vector (matrix) are rejected.
